title: Finite bit construction: two nonpositive helper moves save 11 ADDs on R439
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Finite bit-circuit construction and exact frozen-class minimum; no new kappa.** On PR1062's frozen 11,500-ADD R439 word, the restored noncommuting chain `a ^= b; b ^= c` reduces the complete scalar invoice to **11,489**. Its individual complete gains are **0 and -1**; together it removes fifteen middle ADDs and pays all four new preparation/restoration gates. The correct middle substitution and reverse-order undo are explicit.

Two code-disjoint complete score censuses agree on **77,431,469** eligible triples, **2265** improvements and exactly two eleven-ADD maximizers. All eligible records share digest `142ad23bdd285011e5090ed40b57af69386e7a8c1f259548e83eba66f3f339f3`. The first 32 seed-ordered positive nominees receive complete invoices; all pass. An admitted maximizer proves the exact minimum in this stated class, not global circuit optimality or a best-known count. A separate written support inequality bounds the interaction; finite replay is not formal verification of multiplication.

The winning full-word peaks are **F=25885, B=5977064**: sufficient **96 local /182 nine-stage bits**, below both original strict 104/192 caps. The 2,911 MOVEs, nine COPYs and nine ERASEs, 439 dirty helper roles and rank mass 5,129 remain unchanged. No paid-moment or selected-supplier improvement follows. H2 and literal K_equals_D remain false as in the parent; native/whole-hosted admission and full supplier/outer invoices are unrun.

## Task and overlap

Fresh OS **seed 17**, bit supplier; base **ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6**. Scope **changed** from bit-helper-contract because PR1194/1311 already cover semantic-D substitution. This scalar side result tests a different mechanism: two helper/right shears with nonpositive frozen unilateral gains, on three distinct non-retained parent components. All other fields are fixed. [Local claim/result](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8d17ec366d4e4e50d8f28fdb3f23cf9213417b7a/research/r439-neutral-helper-chain-seed17/CLAIM.json) records three candidates, closed domain and stopping rule. No pinned sprint issue was identified; the user-permitted local fallback is used.

Exact heads: PR1062 **cd016e5dcd5ba28dafa3f3b4eeef003a38e6a11b**; PR965 **6292e3774abd82f2d5202190b498f35cc1628c39**; PR1449 **52a487a0c85e83d875f30a74f795588399bac093**; PR1400 **2515ad2fa93eca3d64523bc55fd70eca08c9aa4b**. [PR1449](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1449) concerns one target plus one helper on PR967; [PR1400](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1400) uses individually positive descent on PR1047; PR965's GL3 region and PR1206's R420 chains differ. Their mechanisms are credited and their savings are not combined.

The final refresh read newest 20 open PR bodies through PR1538, all 15 helper/noncommuting keyword matches, the current Discussion first page and pinned start thread. PR1520's J3 precision frontier and PR1535's B509 inverse-frame audit concern different obligations. An immediate recheck reached PR1541’s different coordinate-swap theorem. This is bounded overlap evidence; not all PRs/comments were freshly paginated. Upstream reached **55a02580ce1b283026e9d3b3510b218f8c93a4de**; guidance and all ten consumed input pins remain unchanged. Only this twelve-file research package is added.

## Validation

Python 3.10+, standard library; tested CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64:

~~~sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/r439-neutral-helper-chain-seed17/test_package.py
~~~

Expected: `PASS_R439_CHAIN_PACKAGE full_censuses=2 trials=32 controls=11 relocation=1 no_new_kappa`.

Both full censuses, all 32 full forward/reverse dirty-column trials, literal exporter/owner/frame and strict precision invoices pass. Thirteen primary semantic controls and eleven actual file-corruption controls reject, including wrong noncommuting order, omitted undo, undercharging, cap equality, duplicate keys and omission of a consumed source pin. Minimal offline relocation into a path with spaces and equivalent gzip repackaging pass; default replay preserves evidence and fails on missing evidence. Parent positive replay, selected-record guard, nine finite-bit-contract and five selected-result tests pass. Remote and staged Git trees match byte-for-byte. [Validation and unrun obligations](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8d17ec366d4e4e50d8f28fdb3f23cf9213417b7a/research/r439-neutral-helper-chain-seed17/VALIDATION.md).

No Linux, Lean, independent human review, native multistage replay, full selected cold replay or hosted CI success is claimed. All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, physical hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain. Selected frontier and upstream/ are unchanged.

[Sources and full credit](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8d17ec366d4e4e50d8f28fdb3f23cf9213417b7a/research/r439-neutral-helper-chain-seed17/README.md). Prepared for **@ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate bounded support-set and proof-review workers. AI implementations are not independent human review. Apache-2.0; predecessor notices remain untouched.

## Open next questions

Can a neutral chain remove a paid helper width rather than only scalar work? First derive both dirty-input and clean-response first-contact footprints across the actual chronology. The zero middle column alone cannot remove helper 570: preparation, undo and continuation still read it. A legal lifecycle and complete recursive invoice are blockers. This extension is not pursued here.
